code_snippets:
import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# Query mean hourly AQHI for weekdays (Jan 20-24, 2025) and weekend (Jan 25-26, 2025) at station 15
query = text("""
SELECT 
    AVG(CASE 
        WHEN datetime >= '2025-01-20' AND datetime < '2025-01-25' THEN aqhi 
    END) as weekday_mean_aqhi,
    AVG(CASE 
        WHEN datetime >= '2025-01-25' AND datetime < '2025-01-27' THEN aqhi 
    END) as weekend_mean_aqhi
FROM hourly_station_air_quality
WHERE station_id = 15
AND datetime >= '2025-01-20' AND datetime < '2025-01-27'
""")

result = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
print(result)

# Store results in variables
weekday_mean_aqhi = float(result['weekday_mean_aqhi'].values[0])
weekend_mean_aqhi = float(result['weekend_mean_aqhi'].values[0])

print(f"\nWeekday mean AQHI (Jan 20-24): {weekday_mean_aqhi:.2f}")
print(f"Weekend mean AQHI (Jan 25-26): {weekend_mean_aqhi:.2f}")
print(f"Difference (Weekday - Weekend): {weekday_mean_aqhi - weekend_mean_aqhi:.2f}")
